Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week. MediQuant is moving quickly — we have an ML product roadmap that will rely on Redwood's Hosted API for document ingestion, entity extraction, and embedding lookups. Our initial scoping (attached) shows a 12-month expected consumption of ~1.1B tokens (peak seasonality in Q4).

- Can Redwood support a committed, annual usage contract (12 months)?
- We need multi-region availability (US + EU) and a 99.95% uptime commitment.
- Pricing ask: given the commit and reference integration, procurement is asking for a 30% list discount to your Hosted API usage rates.

Please let us know what you can approve on discount and any non-standard commercial terms you will need. We prefer a bundled contract (usage commitment + enterprise support) if that helps.

Attaching our internal projection and procurement checklist.

Thanks,
Sara Patel

MediQuant

Subject: Re: Scaling proposal for MediQuant — Hosted API pricing & commitment

Sara — really appreciate the clear numbers and the fast timeline. We can absolutely support multi-region Hosted API and enterprise SLAs via our Dedicated routing + fallback policies; the Hosted API can be configured with region preference to satisfy EU residency concerns.

Preliminary commercial note: list-level discounts >20% require VP-level sign-off. For deals at your scale I'd like to propose a structured offer: 12-month committed usage, minimum billing cadence quarterly, and a stepped discount profile (25% first 6 months, then 20% baseline) OR a flat 30% if MediQuant signs a 2-year commitment and agrees to an onboarding milestone.

I will run the exact math with ops and legal, but wanted to confirm we received your ask. Can you confirm the governance contact for procurement and whether they will accept electronic signatures?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding the request from MediQuant (attached projections). Quick summary and ask below.

Summary:
- Account: MediQuant (Healthcare analytics)
- Deal (HubSpot): HSP-2391 — https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/HSP-2391
- Expected committed usage: ~1.1B tokens over 12 months (~$720k ARR at list rate)
- Customer request: 30% off Hosted API usage. Also asks for 99.95% SLA in contract and multi-region availability (US + EU).

Why this matters:
- Strategic reference in healthcare vertical; product-led usage could expand to other teams if we land enterprise contract.
- Risk: 30% is materially below our published discount thresholds — would reduce first-year unit revenue and sets a precedent for other mid-market healthcare accounts.

Ask (decision requested by EOD Fri 7/13):
1) Approval to offer up to 30% off list for year-1 in exchange for a 12-month commit + onboarding milestones (technical integration and go-live within 90 days), OR
2) Counterproposal authority to offer 25% off flat for 12 months with standard terms and revenue recognition at net-30 billing.

Attached: pricing_projection_MQ_HSP-2391.xlsx, SOW_MediQuant_v1.pdf, procurement_requirements.pdf
HubSpot notes + pricing calc inline.

Risks/Dependencies:
- Legal will need to confirm SLA language; provisioning multi-region Hosted API has modest infra work but ops has confirmed capacity for the requested level.
- Discounts >20% require VP signoff per concession policy.

Recommended route: ask for 2-year lock or onboarding milestone to get to 30%. If customer refuses, approve up to 25% and keep the net economics protected (upfront commit, quarterly billing).

Ben / Marissa / Lauren — can you weigh in? I included the deal link and DocuSign envelope that procurement prefers.

Thanks,
Karthik
